subject: literacy
concept: Understanding plagiarism and why giving credit for others' information and ideas matters
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.concrete: Student compares a properly credited piece of work to an uncredited copy and discusses the difference
exercise.pictorial: Student sorts examples into 'giving credit' and 'not giving credit' categories
exercise.abstract: Student explains, in their own words, why copying someone's work without credit is a problem

misconception_flags: believes changing a few words is sufficient to avoid needing to give credit

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
